metadata.title: Jackson Hole Symposium kicks off, Marvell & dollar stores report earnings: What to Watch

content.text:
00:03 Speaker A
Time for our what to watch Thursday, August 27th. And after Nvidia's much anticipated earnings report, Marvell is giving us another critical read on the AI trade. Investors focusing on whether AI data center demand momentum can keep going. And I was expecting results to top expectations, but the big question will be whether Marvell raises its outlook again as hyperscaler spending continues.
00:23 Speaker A
Also reporting rivals Dollar General and Dollar Tree, giving us two important reads on the value seeking consumer. And I expecting Dollar General to see a mid-single digit sales growth with higher income shoppers continuing to trade down, but its core lower income customer remains under pressure from inflation and changes to snap benefits. At Dollar Tree, investors will be watching whether they can company can extend its first quarter momentum. And also forecasting same store sales toward the high end of its forecast.
00:54 Speaker A
And finally, the Fed's Jackson Hole Economic Policy symposium kicking off the first under Fed chair Kevin Warsh. comes with longer-term yields rising, three FOMC dissents at their July meeting, and uncertainty around inflation and the path for rates.
